notes.query_counting: Query count tracked via SQLAlchemy before_cursor_execute event listener attached to the shared engine.
notes.session: Fresh Session created per scenario call via Session(engine). Identity map cleared between iterations.
notes.A3: query_count_median: 100 — SQLAlchemy lazy-loads user per order via SELECT, confirming N+1 behaviour.
notes.A4: query_count_median: 1 — joinedload resolves N+1 in a single query.
notes.B1: query_count_median: 1 — nested joinedload across 3 levels in single query. unique() required due to joined collection loading.
notes.B3: query_count_median: 2 — 1 query for Tag lookup + 1 query for products with joinedload on category.
notes.C1: query_count_median: 21 — 20 INSERT chunks (executemany per chunk) + 1 DELETE cleanup.
notes.C2: query_count_median: 2 — native SQL UPDATE FROM subquery (LIMIT 1000) + restore. SQLAlchemy ORM update() does not support LIMIT. See methodology/c2_limit_analysis.json.
notes.D1: query_count_median: 7 — 1 SELECT products + 1 INSERT order (flush) + 5 INSERT items (flush via commit) + 2 DELETE cleanup. stddev high due to variable number of products per random offset.

A1.description: Simple SELECT by primary key via Session.get()

A2.description: Filtered list with ORDER BY and LIMIT via select(Product)

A3.description: N+1 diagnostic — 100 orders, lazy-loads user per order (intentional)

A4.description: Eager loading via joinedload(Order.user) — single query

B1.description: Deep eager load via nested joinedload — Order → Items → Product → Category in single query

B2.description: Aggregate with GROUP BY via func.count() and func.avg()

B3.description: Many-to-many via join(Product.tags) with joinedload(Product.category) — 2 queries

C1.description: Bulk insert — 10,000 products in chunks of 500 via session.execute(insert(Product), rows)

C2.description: Bulk update — native SQL UPDATE FROM subquery, LIMIT 1000 rows (see methodology/c2_limit_analysis.json)

D1.description: Unit of Work — session.add() + flush() + commit(): order with 5 items, 7 queries total
